analytics_source_file: A generated performance HTML report, raw CSV capture, or existing *.analytics.json to upload. After a successful Convert, this field is auto-filled with the generated JSON so Upload can run immediately.
analytics_output_dir: Optional. Folder where *.analytics.json is written when you click Convert. If empty, the JSON is written next to the Source File. When set with no Source File, every *.analytics.json in this folder becomes the upload target list.
analytics_upload_url: Elasticsearch or OpenSearch document endpoint, for example http://host:9200/telemetry-cerebrus-performance/_doc.
analytics_btn_convert: Convert the selected Source File (HTML/CSV/JSON) into a normalized *.analytics.json. Written to Output File Path if set, otherwise next to the source. The generated path is auto-selected as the new Source File.
analytics_btn_upload: Upload one document at a time. If Source File points to a *.analytics.json, that file is uploaded; if Source File is empty and Output File Path is a folder, every *.analytics.json in it is uploaded. PUT with report_fingerprint as _id keeps re-uploads idempotent.
analytics_btn_use_profiling_output: Set Output File Path to the Profiling tab's current output directory.
